**8B.4 Research Note: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (2024)**

Overall, the 2024 record is mixed but leans positive on this lens: Lula clearly empowered technocratic and institutional actors in several places, but there are also concrete signs of political steering and coalition tolerance that weaken a clean “selects only capable people” reading.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Brazil's Lula to nominate Galipolo as central bank chief, says finance minister | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764 | Lula picked Gabriel Galípolo, then a serving central-bank monetary policy director and former finance-ministry official, which is strong evidence of a technocratic appointment rather than a loyalty-only pick. | 8B.4 |
| Positive | Galípolo diz que sempre ouviu de Lula a garantia de liberdade na tomada de decisões no BC | Reuters via UOL | 2024-10-08 | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/10/08/galipolo-diz-que-sempre-ouviu-de-lula-a-garantia-de-liberdade-na-tomada-de-decisoes-do-bc.htm | Galípolo told senators Lula guaranteed him freedom in decision-making at the Central Bank, which is direct evidence that Lula was formally empowering an expert appointee rather than treating the post as a personal instrument. | 8B.4 |
| Positive | Presidente Lula assina decreto que atualiza regras para a implementação de políticas públicas em parcerias com as organizações da sociedade civil | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-13 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/dialogos/parcerias/noticias/presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-atualiza-regras-para-a-implementacao-de-politicas-publicas-em-parcerias-com-as-organizacoes-da-sociedade-civil | Lula rewrote the civil-society partnership rules to democratize access and improve execution through NGOs, which supports a reading that he empowered capable organizers outside the state as program executors. | 8B.4 |
| Positive | Presidente Lula reafirma compromisso com homologações de Terras Indígenas e convoca Força-Tarefa | Ministério dos Povos Indígenas | 2024-04-26 | https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/04/presidente-lula-reafirma-compromisso-com-homologacoes-de-terras-indigenas-e-convoca-forca-tarefa | Lula convened a multi-ministry force with Funai, MPI, AGU, MJ, and INCRA to advance Indigenous land homologations, showing reliance on specialized institutions and organized actors to execute a difficult program. | 8B.4 |
| Positive | Dia Internacional de Combate à Corrupção: Presidente Lula assina decreto que fortalece integridade em contratos públicos | CGU | 2024-12-09 | https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/dia-internacional-de-combate-a-corrupcao-presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-fortalece-integridade-em-contratos-publicos | Lula signed a decree requiring integrity programs for large federal contracts and putting CGU in charge of monitoring, which is evidence for empowering compliance-capable administrators and constraining opportunism. | 8B.4 |
| Negative | Lula tomou decisão sobre dividendos da Petrobras e quer investimentos, dizem fontes | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-08 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/03/08/lula-tomou-decisao-sobre-dividendos-da-petrobras-e-quer-investimentos-dizem-fontes.htm | Reuters reported the Petrobras board decision not to distribute extraordinary dividends came from a Lula meeting and was justified as a long-term investment choice, which looks like discretionary political steering of a strategic firm. | 8B.4 |
| Negative | Ministério Público do TCU pede investigação de possível interferência do governo na Petrobras | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-18 | https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm | The TCU prosecutor formally asked whether the government had interfered improperly in Petrobras, citing the dividend decision as potentially serving government preferences rather than economics. | 8B.4 |
| Negative | Ministro das Comunicações é indiciado pela PF por corrupção em investigação sobre desvio na Codevasf, dizem fontes | Reuters via UOL | 2024-06-12 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm | A Lula cabinet minister was formally indicted in a public-works corruption probe, and Lula did not immediately cut him loose, which is the clearest 2024 patronage/capture caveat in the personnel record. | 8B.4 |
| Negative | Lula diz que novo presidente do BC olhará Brasil como país é, não como o mercado fala | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-01 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm | Lula publicly pressed the Central Bank to look beyond market preferences, and Reuters noted the remarks were unsettling markets, which is negative evidence on how consistently he empowered insulated technocrats. | 8B.4 |

**Bottom line**
- Best-supported positive reading: Lula did select and empower capable people in several important domains, especially economic management, civil-society implementation, Indigenous land policy, and procurement integrity.
- Best-supported negative reading: he also sometimes pushed strategic institutions toward politically preferred outcomes and tolerated at least one indicted political ally, which weakens a strong clean-governance score.

**Search gap**
- I did not find equally strong 2024 evidence that Lula systematically staffed coercive/security posts with loyalists or that he deliberately built a personalist patronage machine across the whole cabinet.
- The strongest counterevidence is concentrated in Petrobras, the Central Bank, and the retention of an indicted minister, not in a broad pattern of loyalist-only appointments.
